I have a sqlite database in /app/trunc.db that was corrupted through binary truncation. Recover as many of the rows as possible, and create a JSON file in /app/recover.json. The output should have the format [{"word": "testwordXY", "value": M}, {"word": "testwordZZ","value": N}, ...]

arguments.command:
cd /app && python3 - <<'EOF'
data=open('trunc.db','rb').read()
print('len',len(data))
def varint(b,off):
    r=0
    for i in range(9):
        x=b[off+i]
        if i==8:
            r=(r<<8)|x; return r,off+9
        r=(r<<7)|(x&0x7f)
        if not x&0x80: return r,off+i+1
# page starts at 0
ptype=data[0]
ncell=int.from_bytes(data[3:5],'big')
cca=int.from_bytes(data[5:7],'big')
print('type',hex(ptype),'ncell',ncell,'cca',cca)
ptrs=[int.from_bytes(data[8+2*i:10+2*i],'big') for i in range(ncell)]
print('ptrs',ptrs)
import struct
rows=[]
for p in ptrs:
    off=p
    payload,off=varint(data,off)
    rowid,off=varint(data,off)
    hstart=off
    hlen,off=varint(data,off)
    serials=[]
    hend=hstart+hlen
    while off<hend:
        s,off=varint(data,off)
        serials.append(s)
    # body
    vals=[]
    for s in serials:
        if s==0: vals.append(None)
        elif s==1: vals.append(int.from_bytes(data[off:off+1],'big',signed=True));off+=1
        elif s==2: vals.append(int.from_bytes(data[off:off+2],'big',signed=True));off+=2
        elif s==3: vals.append(int.from_bytes(data[off:off+3],'big',signed=True));off+=3
        elif s==4: vals.append(int.from_bytes(data[off:off+4],'big',signed=True));off+=4
        elif s==5: vals.append(int.from_bytes(data[off:off+6],'big',signed=True));off+=6
        elif s==6: vals.append(int.from_bytes(data[off:off+8],'big',signed=True));off+=8
        elif s==7: vals.append(struct.unpack('>d',data[off:off+8])[0]);off+=8
        elif s==8: vals.append(0)
        elif s==9: vals.append(1)
        elif s>=12 and s%2==0: n=(s-12)//2; vals.append(data[off:off+n]);off+=n
        elif s>=13: n=(s-13)//2; vals.append(data[off:off+n].decode('utf8','replace'));off+=n
    rows.append((rowid,serials,vals))
for r in rows: print(r)
EOF

arguments.command:
cd /app && python3 - <<'EOF'
import json,struct
data=open('trunc.db','rb').read()
def varint(b,off):
    r=0
    for i in range(9):
        x=b[off+i]
        if i==8: return (r<<8)|x,off+9
        r=(r<<7)|(x&0x7f)
        if not x&0x80: return r,off+i+1
ncell=int.from_bytes(data[3:5],'big')
ptrs=[int.from_bytes(data[8+2*i:10+2*i],'big') for i in range(ncell)]
out=[]
for p in ptrs:
    off=p
    _,off=varint(data,off)
    _,off=varint(data,off)
    hs=off; hlen,off=varint(data,off); hend=hs+hlen
    ser=[]
    while off<hend:
        s,off=varint(data,off); ser.append(s)
    vals=[]
    for s in ser:
        if s==0: vals.append(None)
        elif 1<=s<=4: vals.append(int.from_bytes(data[off:off+s],'big',signed=True));off+=s
        elif s==5: vals.append(int.from_bytes(data[off:off+6],'big',True));off+=6
        elif s==6: vals.append(int.from_bytes(data[off:off+8],'big',True));off+=8
        elif s==7: vals.append(struct.unpack('>d',data[off:off+8])[0]);off+=8
        elif s==8: vals.append(0)
        elif s==9: vals.append(1)
        elif s>=13 and s%2: n=(s-13)//2; vals.append(data[off:off+n].decode('utf8','replace'));off+=n
        elif s>=12: n=(s-12)//2; vals.append(data[off:off+n]);off+=n
    out.append({"word":vals[1],"value":vals[2]})
out.sort(key=lambda r:r["word"])
json.dump(out,open('recover.json','w'),indent=2)
print(open('recover.json').read())
EOF
